boardName: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE - ICSE & ISC)

title.en: Unit 1: Patterns in Mathematics, Prime Time & Number Play
title.hi: इकाई 1: गणित में पैटर्न, अभाज्य संख्याएं और संख्या खेल

competencies: Identifies figurate number sequences, Virahanka numbers, and prime factorisation trees
Evaluates divisibility tests, HCF/LCM, and integer operations on the number line

title.en: Unit 2: Fractions, Rational Numbers, Ratios & Linear Algebra
title.hi: इकाई 2: भिन्न, परिमेय संख्याएं, अनुपात और रैखिक बीजगणित

competencies: Models multi-step word problems using algebraic expressions and linear equations
Solves percentage, profit/loss, simple/compound interest, and direct/inverse proportion tasks

title.en: Unit 3: Lines and Angles, Triangles, Symmetry & Perimeter/Area/Volume
title.hi: इकाई 3: रेखाएं और कोण, त्रिभुज, सममिति तथा क्षेत्रमिति

competencies: Constructs geometric figures with ruler and compass and proves triangle congruence
Computes area of polygons and surface area/volume of cubes, cuboids, and cylinders

title.en: Unit 1: Materials Around Us, States of Water & Separation Methods
title.hi: इकाई 1: हमारे चारों ओर के पदार्थ, जल की अवस्थाएं और पृथक्करण

competencies: Classifies materials by solubility, density, conductivity, and chemical change
Designs filtration, evaporation, and distillation experiments

title.en: Unit 2: Living Creatures, Mindful Eating, Cell & Body Movements
title.hi: इकाई 2: सजीव जगत, संतुलित आहार, कोशिका और शरीर की गति

competencies: Tests food samples for carbohydrates, proteins, and fats and maps deficiency prevention
Explains plant/animal adaptations, respiration, and microscopic cell structures

title.en: Unit 3: Measurement of Length/Motion, Temperature, Magnets & Beyond Earth
title.hi: इकाई 3: लंबाई और गति का मापन, तापमान, चुंबक और अंतरिक्ष

competencies: Measures SI units, plots distance-time graphs, and builds simple electric and magnetic circuits
Explains heat transfer (conduction, convection, radiation) and solar system dynamics

name.en: Social Science (Exploring Society: India and Beyond)
name.hi: सामाजिक विज्ञान (समाज की खोज: भारत और उससे आगे)

textbooks: NCERT Exploring Society: India and Beyond (NCF-SE 2023 Series)

title.en: Themes A & B: India and the World (Landforms, Oceans) & Tapestry of the Past
title.hi: विषय A और B: भू-आकृतियां, महासागर और अतीत की धरोहर

competencies: Locates latitudes, longitudes, time zones, and major landforms on thematic maps
Analyses Harappan urban planning, Vedic/Janapada traditions, and historical sources

title.en: Themes C, D & E: Cultural Heritage, Grassroots Democracy & Economic Life
title.hi: विषय C, D और E: सांस्कृतिक विरासत, जमीनी लोकतंत्र और आर्थिक जीवन

competencies: Compares Three-Tier Panchayati Raj and Urban Local Bodies governance structures
Classifies primary, secondary, and tertiary economic activities and household budgeting

title.en: Literature, Grammar in Context, Unseen Reading & Essay Writing
title.hi: साहित्य पठन, संदर्भगत व्याकरण, अपठित गद्यांश और निबंध लेखन

competencies: Synthesizes themes across Indian and global prose/poetry in Hindi and English
Drafts structured essays, notices, and formal letters with accurate syntax

name.en: Computational Thinking, Coding & Vocational Exposure (Kaushal Bodh)
name.hi: कम्प्यूटेशनल चिंतन, कोडिंग और कौशल बोध

title.en: Algorithms, Data Tables, Python Basics & Ethical AI
title.hi: एल्गोरिदम, डेटा तालिका, पायथन परिचय और नैतिक एआई

competencies: Designs flowcharts, loops, and conditional logic for real-world problems
Completes hands-on Kaushal Bodh projects across data, ecology, and community service

title.en: Term 1: Foundational Concepts, Inquiry & Formative Portfolio
title.hi: सत्र 1: मूल अवधारणाएं, अन्वेषण और रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन

title.en: Term 2: Applied Problem Solving, Integration & Annual Consolidation
title.hi: सत्र 2: अनुप्रयुक्त समस्या समाधान, एकीकरण और वार्षिक पुनरावृत्ति

termPlan.milestoneAssessment: Term 2 Annual Board-Pattern / Stage Mastery Examination

title.en: 1. Prerequisite Warm-Up & Real-World Hook
title.hi: 1. पूर्व-ज्ञान पुनरावृत्ति और वास्तविक जीवन से जुड़ाव

steps.description: 2-question retrieval check on prerequisite skill node before introducing new concept.

title.en: 2. Sourced Concept & Worked Example (EN/HI)
title.hi: 2. प्रमाणित अवधारणा और हल किया गया उदाहरण (द्विभाषी)

steps.description: Concise explanation grounded in official textbook/framework source with zero unverified claims.

title.en: 3. Adaptive Guided Practice & 3-Step Hint Ladder
title.hi: 3. निर्देशित अभ्यास और 3-स्तरीय संकेत सीढ़ी

steps.description: 3 to 5 scaffolded practice tasks (offline toy/workbook task for under-6, interactive problems for Classes 1-12).

title.en: 4. Mastery Exit Ticket & Evidence Event
title.hi: 4. दक्षता जांच और प्रगति साक्ष्य

steps.description: Deterministic mastery check that updates the learner's skill graph state and schedules spaced review.

internals.format: Periodic tests (5 marks), multiple assessment (5 marks), portfolio/workbooks (5 marks), subject enrichment/lab work (5 marks)

termExams.frequency: End of Term 1 (Week 18) and End of Term 2 (Week 36)
termExams.marksOrScale: 80 marks theory + 20 marks internal (or 70 + 30 for senior lab sciences)

title.en: Indian Art, Craft, Music & Theatre Studio
title.hi: भारतीय कला, शिल्प, संगीत और रंगमंच

coCurricularPlan.description: Hands-on sketching, clay modelling, folk rhythm, and dramatic storytelling aligned with NCF-SE Art Education.

title.en: Daily Outdoor Movement, Yoga & Indigenous Games
title.hi: दैनिक आउटडोर खेल, योग और स्वदेशी खेल

coCurricularPlan.description: Structured physical play, flexibility, breathwork, and team coordination off-screen.

title.en: Neighbourhood Science, Nature & Maker Pod
title.hi: पड़ोस विज्ञान, प्रकृति और नवाचार समूह

extracurricularPlan.peerPodMode: Small group of 4-6 learners building offline experiments, nature journals, or coding projects together.

title.en: Bilingual Kahani, Debate & Seva Circle
title.hi: द्विभाषी कहानी, वाद-विवाद और सेवा मंडल

extracurricularPlan.peerPodMode: Moderated oral expression, debate, and local community/environmental stewardship.
